title: [Decision] Where the shared Company Core ontology lives: an app package in the objectstack monorepo, its own repository, platform-objects sys_* objects, or no shared core?
body:
**Filing gate ③** (maintainer-directed). The maintainer in this session, 2026-10-27, verbatim: 「Company Core 共享本体放 objectstack 单仓。创建 issue 决策卡」 and 「你应该使用 pm-dispatch 技能创建issue」. The card records the options the maintainer's wording leans against, with premises and re-checks, so the ruling exists once on the board rather than as a chat line.

**Filed by** `session_01J8VVAjRKqdoEYQ4hXxtBuf` on the maintainer's instruction. ⛔ Not a claim. No `domain:*` label: triage routes the execution cards after the ruling (candidate lanes: `domain:server` for the package; `domain:spec` only if a namespace rule changes).

**Business reason.** Three downstream apps each define "a company we deal with" on their own: HotCRM `crm_account` / `crm_contact`, HotCLM `clm_party`, ATS `ats_employer`. A customer who installs two of them gets two unrelated customer tables, and an agent operating across them has no shared meaning of "this counterparty". A shared Company Core (party, contact, legal entity, department, address, currency, document, task, approval contract) is the base package every functional app would depend on (ADR-0141). Where that package lives decides its release cadence, who gates changes to it, and whether a platform PR can break every app at once without noticing.

### 维护者速读
- 一句话问题：所有业务应用共用的基础本体（往来单位与联系人、法人实体与部门、地址、币种、文档、任务、审批契约）放在哪里开发与发版。
- 谁撞上了（实测）：hotcrm、hotclm、ats 三个仓各自定义了"公司/联系人"对象（`crm_account`、`clm_party`、`ats_employer`），同装两个应用即两张互不相通的客户表。
- 选项：**A** 平台单仓内作为独立 App 工件、随平台发版；**B** 独立仓 `objectstack-ai/company-core`；**C** 并入 platform-objects 作 `sys_*` 常驻对象；**D** 不建共享核心，各应用自带、靠 ADR-0141 依赖 HotCRM。
- **推荐 A。** 回退 B。
- 请回：`A / B / C / D`，并一并裁定命名空间（见「After the ruling」第 1 条）。

### Background
- The marketplace survey of 2026-10-27 (this session) found the only v18-current listed app is HotCRM; HotCLM, ATS, Duly and the templates repository each pin an older platform and each model the counterparty independently. Readings on `objectstack-ai/hotcrm@9464673`, `objectstack-ai/hotclm@3b7364f`, `objectstack-ai/ats` (head of 2026-09-09), `objectstack-ai/duly` (head of 2026-10-26), this repository at `c3fb185a`.
- ADR-0141 D7 names the first dependency consumer: a HotCRM module shipping on its own. A Company Core package is the second shape of the same mechanism: a base that many apps declare.
- Nothing in the platform defines a business party today. `sys_organization` is the tenant organization (ADR-0029 D2's identity hub), not a customer or supplier.

### Governing text
- **ADR-0029 D2**: "Core-mandatory — referenced by (almost) everything and has no meaningful 'disabled' state: the identity/org hub (`sys_user`, `sys_organization`) and the metadata store … Capability — has a coherent on/off boundary … Independently installable/disablable; each owns its `sys_*` objects." Re-check: `git grep -n "Small core; everything else is a capability plugin" origin/main -- docs/adr`.
- **ADR-0029 D4**: "a `scope:'project'` / `type:'app'` package attempting to own/define an object in a reserved kernel namespace is rejected (the `sys_`-prefix exemption becomes a prohibition for apps). Apps may still extend kernel objects." Re-check: `git grep -n "apps reference but cannot define kernel objects" origin/main -- docs/adr`.
- **ADR-0019 D2**: "Only `type: app` is consumer-installable; everything else is invisible." Re-check: `git grep -n "is consumer-installable; everything else is invisible" origin/main -- docs/adr`.
- **ADR-0141 D1 / D2 / D5**: dependencies are declared in `ManifestSchema.dependencies`, checked once before install, and "A declared dependency is namespace co-ownership, one-way". Re-check: `git grep -n "A declared dependency is namespace co-ownership" origin/main -- docs/adr`.
- **AGENTS.md Prime Directive #6**: "For module prefixes, embed in the name (`sys_user`, `ai_conversations`)"; **ADR-0129**: an object name carries its module prefix literally.
- `packages/spec/src/kernel/manifest.zod.ts` lines 531–532: "Platform-reserved namespaces: "base", "system", "sys". Object names starting with `sys_` are reserved for the platform". Re-check: `git grep -n "Platform-reserved namespaces" origin/main -- packages/spec/src/kernel/manifest.zod.ts`.
- pm-dispatch `references/decision-analysis.md` 〈应用仓推荐序特例〉: 「能力先建在平台(spec、objectstack 运行时、objectui 渲染器);应用仓(cloud、hotcrm)不自建替代。」

**Protocol statement.** No spec key changes under A, B or D. C changes what `sys_*` means (ADR-0029 D2 would gain a third tier) and needs an ADR amendment first. Under A, B or D the core's namespace is an ordinary app namespace and cannot be `sys`, `base` or `system` (reserved); the ruling should name it (candidate: `core`, objects `core_party`, `core_contact`, `core_legal_entity`, …), because ADR-0129 makes the prefix literal and permanent.

### Premises (each with a re-check)
1. No platform object models a business party. Re-check: `git grep -n -i "counterparty\|core_party\|business party" origin/main -- packages/platform-objects/src` (expected 0 hits).
2. Three downstream apps each own a party-like object. Re-check: `ls hotcrm/src/*/objects | grep -E "account|contact"`; `ls hotclm/src/objects | grep party`; `ls ats/src/objects | grep employer`.
3. The ADR-0141 D2 pre-install dependency check is live, so a base package can be declared and its absence refused. Re-check: `git grep -n "checkDeclaredDependencies" origin/main -- packages/cloud-connection/src`.
4. A metadata app package in this monorepo is an existing shape (`packages/apps/setup`, `packages/apps/studio`, `packages/apps/account` are manifest packages; `examples/app-multi-package` builds two packages in one artifact). Re-check: `ls packages/apps examples/app-multi-package/src`.
5. Apps must not define `sys_*` objects (ADR-0029 D4). Re-check: `git grep -n "RESERVED_NAMESPACES" origin/main -- packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` (the set currently holds `base` and `system`; the enforcement site of the `sys` prohibition for apps is not re-verified here).

### Options
| Option | What it does | What a customer or app author sees | Effort |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **A** monorepo app package | New package under `packages/` (for example `packages/apps/company-core`): a `type: 'app'` package with its own manifest id, namespace and semver, built and published as its own artifact on the platform release train; every platform PR's CI builds and installs it. Apps depend on it through `manifest.dependencies`. | One "Company Core" app in the marketplace, installed once; CRM, CLM, procurement attach to its party. A platform change that breaks it is red in the platform PR. | `domain:server` · 1 PR (package) + 1 PR (CI install leg) · no precedent measured for a business-metadata package under `packages/`; nearest shape `packages/apps/setup`. |
| **B** own repository | `objectstack-ai/company-core` with its own PM loop and release; this repository runs it in a downstream canary. | Same marketplace shape as A. A platform change that breaks it surfaces in the canary after the platform merge, not in the platform PR. | 1 new repository + repo kit + canary workflow here · precedent: hotcrm (separate repository, own loop) · no measured PR. |
| **C** fold into platform-objects as `sys_*` | Party, address, currency, document become kernel objects: always present, not installable, not removable. | No separate app; every environment carries a party table whether or not any business app is installed. | `domain:server` · 1–2 PRs + an ADR amending 0029 D2/D4 (Tier H). |
| **D** no shared core | Each app keeps its own party; a second app depends on HotCRM and reuses `crm_account` (the ADR-0141 D7 route). | Installing CLM or procurement requires CRM. "Customer" means CRM's account everywhere. | 0 PRs now; each later app pays its own party model or a CRM dependency. |

**In business terms.**
- A: one shared address book, shipped and tested with the platform, installed as an app.
- B: the same address book kept by a separate team with its own release calendar.
- C: the address book is part of the operating system; you cannot not have it.
- D: no shared address book; every app copies the CRM's or keeps its own.

### 四维分析(业务立场)
- **项目长远合理性(领起)。** 两年后的样子：一家公司在平台上的"往来单位、法人、地址、币种"只有一份定义，每个职能应用声明依赖它（ADR-0141），对应 Salesforce 的 Account/Contact 标准对象、SAP 的业务伙伴（Business Partner）、Palantir 的共享本体。A 与 B 都到达这个终态，差别只在谁为它的契约负责：A 把它放在平台 PR 的 CI 半径内，契约与 spec 同级受护，缩小特例；B 多一个仓与一条异步金丝雀，破坏在平台合并之后才被看见。C 把业务本体塞进 `sys_*`，违反 ADR-0029 D2/D4 的两层划分（身份枢纽 + 能力插件），是永久特例。D 让"客户"永久等于 CRM 的账户，CLM、采购、GRC 都要先装 CRM，契约随 CRM 的产品节奏漂移。
- **实际业务拉动。** 有实测拉动：hotcrm `crm_account`、hotclm `clm_party`、ats `ats_employer` 三份互不相通的"公司"定义；hotclm DESIGN 已为"相对方"单独建模，并把 CRM 交接做成一条同步流程（F15）。有拉动 ⇒ 一次付清长远形态。
- **防 AI 犯错。** 出错时谁看到什么：A/B 下，写 CLM 元数据的 AI 引用 `core_party` 而核心未装时，在安装门被响亮拒绝（ADR-0141 D2）；C 下对象常驻，无法拒绝"没装核心"，也无法卸载；D 下 AI 要在每个应用里重写一遍 party，批量犯错的面最大。A 比 B 多一道门：平台 PR 改坏核心时 CI 当场红，而非金丝雀事后红。
- **创业阶段不扩散。** A 不加新门禁、不加协议键，复用现有 manifest 包与 `dependencies`；B 多一个仓的运营成本；C 要改 ADR（Tier H）并让每个环境背一张用不到的表；D 零工作量但把扩散推给每个新应用。

### os-decision-facets
- ① 项目长远合理性：A 缩小特例（一份业务本体，契约在平台 CI 半径内，合 ADR-0029 两层划分与 ADR-0141 依赖）；B 同终态但契约护栏异步；C 扩大 `sys_*` 的含义，违 ADR-0029 D2/D4；D 让"客户"永久等于 CRM 账户。
- ② 实际业务拉动：今天 hotcrm、hotclm、ats 各自定义公司对象（`crm_account`、`clm_party`、`ats_employer`），hotclm 还为此写了一条 CRM 交接流程。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错：A/B 缺核心时安装门响亮拒绝；C 无法拒绝也无法卸载；D 每个应用重写一遍 party，错面最大。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散：A 无新门禁无新键；B 多一仓；C 需改 ADR 且每环境常驻一表；D 零工作量但扩散后置。

Prior rulings read: "shared base objects party organization person company core package every app depends" → 1 hit (#26131, an unrelated console check, closed); "company core ontology master data counterparty vendor customer same object across apps" → 1 hit (#14599, multi-package artifact attribution defect, closed); ADR-0141 D7, ADR-0029 D2/D4; thread: none.

### Recommendation
- **A**, fallback **B**.
- 只看①选 A；②③④ 是否翻转：否。
- **Confidence gap:** (i) whether a `type: 'app'` metadata package under `packages/` is published as its own marketplace artifact by the existing release workflow was not measured (premise 4 shows the package shape exists, not the publish leg); (ii) the enforcement site of the `sys` prohibition for apps (ADR-0029 D4) was not re-verified, which matters only for C; (iii) the object roster of the core is a proposal from the 2026-10-27 survey, not a ruled list — this card asks only where it lives; the roster is a follow-up card.

### After the ruling
1. The ruling names the namespace and manifest id in the same breath (candidate `core` / `com.objectstack.core`); `sys`, `base` and `system` are reserved and not candidates.
2. **A:** triage files one `domain:server` card: the package skeleton under `packages/` with manifest, namespace, one anchor-safe default permission set (ADR-0090 D5), build and publish wiring, and a CI leg that installs it on every platform PR; a second card for the object roster, filed after the maintainer reviews the proposed list.
3. **B:** triage files a cross-repo coordination parent: a new repository from the app-repo kit, a canary workflow in this repository, the same roster card.
4. **C:** an ADR amending 0029 D2/D4 first (Tier H), then the package work.
5. **D:** close this card not_planned; the HotCRM module split (ADR-0141 D7) continues as the only dependency route.
6. HotCRM, HotCLM and ATS each get a follow-up card to re-point their party objects at the core once it is published; those cards are filed in their own repositories.

### Related
ADR-0019, ADR-0029, ADR-0129, ADR-0130, ADR-0141 (D7), #25403 (the dependency rulings), #25747 (e-sign connector, a cross-app consumer), #25098.
